digest.component_or_area: plan-authoring author guide and user docs
propositions: The author-facing guides are the only place the Success Criteria / Acceptance Criteria split was described as a real distinction and must be rewritten for the collapsed vocabulary.

The leaf-vs-container section rule must be re-expressed so containers are described by child decomposition covering the parent's acceptance criteria and deferring testing to children, not a vacuous 'containers need Acceptance Criteria'.
The guide is packaged and surfaced by `rebar explain plan`, so its output must contain no Success Criteria vocabulary.
A regex scan for success-criteria vocabulary across the guides and user docs must return no matches, with the named permanent carve-outs left untouched.
The edit is editorial rather than a mechanical rename, distinguishing this ticket from the rest of the epic.
